# EVRUC

> EVRUC is a global online education platform for football (soccer) and sports management, by Loyalty Fans GmbH, a Swiss company. The platform is in English and is coming soon.

## About

- Flagship course: the Football Management Course.
- AI-supported learning: an AI tutor, a community, and certified exams.
- For people who want careers in football clubs, federations, and the sports business.
- Global audience; courses are in English.
- Operated by Loyalty Fans GmbH (Switzerland).

## Status

The platform is launching soon. The website https://evruc.com/ currently shows a coming-soon page.

## Contact

- Website: https://evruc.com/
